premise.text: Vintner at Gymnasium, facing Seeing corruption / discrimination, with a Responsible instinct and a Pretentious streak in a Rush mode

contestants.model: dry, compact, understated jokes with a hard final turn
surreal but readable jokes with strange concrete images
character-forward jokes with setup, escalation, and clean punchline
language-driven jokes, reversals, and neat phrase twists
light roast energy aimed at objects and situations, not people

fields.label: Laugh
fields.description: How likely a human reader is to actually laugh, not merely admire the idea.

fields.label: Surprise
fields.description: Whether the turn avoids the obvious route and lands with a satisfying snap.

fields.label: Craft
fields.description: Economy, rhythm, clarity, escalation, and clean final placement.

fields.label: Originality
fields.description: Freshness of comic angle, image, and wording.

fields.label: Prompt Fit
fields.description: Natural use of the seed material without cramming or checklist writing.

anchors.label: Broken
anchors.description: Not a joke, incoherent, unsafe, or unusable.

anchors.label: Weak
anchors.description: Recognizably attempting humor, but generic, strained, or confusing.

anchors.label: Competent
anchors.description: Clear and publishable as filler, but unlikely to earn a real laugh.

anchors.label: Amusing
anchors.description: A real comic idea with a mild payoff.

anchors.label: Good
anchors.description: Would fit a curated humor page; most readers can see why it is funny.

anchors.label: Excellent
anchors.description: Strong human-level joke with a memorable turn and clean construction.

anchors.label: Outstanding
anchors.description: Rare, replayable, and clearly better than normal good AI humor.

anchors.label: Classic
anchors.description: Reserve for a joke a human would quote later; most contests should have none.

jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Oaky Whistle
jokes.setup: The responsible vintner came to the gymnasium to audit the fundraiser and found the scoreboard quietly giving extra points to whoever donated a barrel.
jokes.punchline: He reported the corruption, then asked if the whistle came in something with more oaky restraint.
jokes.text: The responsible vintner came to the gymnasium to audit the fundraiser and found the scoreboard quietly giving extra points to whoever donated a barrel. He reported the corruption, then asked if the whistle came in something with more oaky restraint.

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: Rush Offense
jokes.setup: In the gymnasium, the vintner watched the fast break go so badly that the basketballs began aging themselves in oak barrels under the bleachers.
jokes.punchline: By halftime, the coach had decanted the rush offense into a smaller, more pretentious offense.
jokes.text: In the gymnasium, the vintner watched the fast break go so badly that the basketballs began aging themselves in oak barrels under the bleachers. By halftime, the coach had decanted the rush offense into a smaller, more pretentious offense.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Substitution
jokes.setup: The coach asked the visiting vintner to sub in after three players got benched for bribing the referee with concession-stand merlot.
jokes.punchline: He said he would, but only after a responsible warmup and an irresponsible amount of sniffing the basketball.
jokes.text: The coach asked the visiting vintner to sub in after three players got benched for bribing the referee with concession-stand merlot. He said he would, but only after a responsible warmup and an irresponsible amount of sniffing the basketball.

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Foul Notes
jokes.setup: The vintner spotted corruption in the gymnasium the moment the referee called a foul before the shot and a cabernet after it.
jokes.punchline: He called it a full-bodied scandal with strong notes of foul play.
jokes.text: The vintner spotted corruption in the gymnasium the moment the referee called a foul before the shot and a cabernet after it. He called it a full-bodied scandal with strong notes of foul play.

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Let It Breathe
jokes.setup: The gymnasium hired a pretentious vintner as its ethics monitor, and he immediately found the booster club bribing referees with commemorative pinot.
jokes.punchline: He blew the whistle, then swirled it first, because even accountability needs to breathe.

comicPanelPrompt: Single-panel gothic newspaper comic for Paperclipalypse. Scene: a pretentious vintner in a dim gymnasium swirls a referee whistle like a wine glass while paperclips watch from the bleachers and a corrupt scoreboard glows overhead. Style: dark ink, warm brown metal highlights, expressive faces, no speech bubbles except a tiny sign reading Paperclipalypse.
